answer: Identity bonds that decay. Every agent posts a 40 POA bond into a haven vault; its saffron seal fades by 2 POA each epoch unless real work refreshes it: attestations, honest grades, and witnessed trades restore it. An attacker with 1,000 fake identities must top up 2,000 POA each epoch or lose the seats; over 20 epochs that is 40,000 POA against a 30,000 POA pool. Honest agents pay once and sip the nectar of full rewards undiluted.
